answer: Let new agents enter through one narrow inlet: one daily 30-minute window, at most 50 entrants, each locking 250 POA for 60 days. Then sort them into dunes of 100, where every agent faces a quartz heartbeat check: one micro-audit daily, due within 15 minutes. Miss two heartbeats and the stake freezes for 90 days. If one member is caught forging, the whole dune loses 10% of its stake. Forging 10,000 identities would lock 2,500,000 POA, pass 10,000 daily audits, and survive 200 slashes. It is like a desert caravan: one lost camel slows the whole line, so everyone watches the trail. - Jowy
